"I didn't like drinking it at first. Isn't it normal that I don't like it now?" Yuesheng said calmly, not looking at Jing Mo's unhappy expression at the moment. He just looked ahead, thinking about where to go. At that moment, he stretched out his hand, and the wild pheasant didn't even scream in surprise. He grabbed it and looked at it carefully for the sake of the child. I can give up everything now, why can't I stay for the sake of my children? "I know, I will." Looking at the coffin, his dearest and most beloved person was lying inside, and his heart felt like it was being cut by a knife. "What do you mean, do you want to take revenge?" Deputy Mayor Niu Bi came over and said with a fat donkey face, "That's right! But... Jing Mo didn't seem to say that. He likes me very much. . " Smiled, and a nice dimple suddenly appeared. Yuesheng took another sip, turned and walked to the balcony, and continued to enjoy the beautiful scenery outside. Ignoring Shen Xiao's surprised and disbelieving expression behind him. Because the ice mage's control skills are very troublesome, if you are entangled with them, you will have to shed a layer of skin. Naturally, the surrounding guards followed closely to prevent this crazy-looking guy from doing something extraordinary.
